context: A uni student presents a political-history thesis to a teacher
purpose: Teach: 安倍/福田/中川/藤田/一郎/仁/隆/剛

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 明日香先生、今日は卒論の中間発表をさせていただきます。テーマは戦後日本の政教分離についてです。
lines.en: Professor Asuka, today I'll present my thesis interim report. The topic is the separation of church and state in postwar Japan.
lines.style: Formal, slightly nervous student opening a presentation

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい、どうぞ。参考文献には岩波新書をいくつか使っていますね。
lines.en: Go ahead. I see you used several Iwanami Shinsho books as references.
lines.style: Calm, encouraging academic tone of a professor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、特に山田一郎先生の著書を中心にまとめました。安倍内閣期の憲法解釈と、福田元総理の発言を比較しています。
lines.en: Yes, I focused mainly on Professor Yamada Ichiro's work. I compare constitutional interpretations during the Abe cabinet with statements from former PM Fukuda.
lines.style: Studious, citing sources with measured and careful pace

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。憲法学者の中川氏の論文には目を通しましたか?彼の主権概念の整理は厳密に組まれていますよ。
lines.en: I see. Have you looked at the constitutional scholar Nakagawa's papers? His framing of sovereignty is strictly constructed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing follow-up from a professor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中川氏の論文も読みました。第三章では国民主権と政教分離の緊張関係を分析する予定です。
lines.en: Yes, I read Nakagawa's papers. In chapter three I plan to analyze the tension between popular sovereignty and church-state separation.
lines.style: Confident progression through the outline of chapters

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い視点ですね。藤田監督のドキュメンタリーに、占領期の最高司令官と宗教政策の場面があります。映像資料として推奨します。
lines.en: A good viewpoint. Director Fujita's documentary has scenes about the supreme commander and religious policy during the occupation. I recommend it as a visual source.
lines.style: Constructive suggestion with warm professorial guidance

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。藤田監督の作品、必ず観ます。隆盛を誇った戦前の国家神道がどう解体されたかも、剛健な仁愛の思想と対比して論じたいです。
lines.en: Thank you. I'll definitely watch Director Fujita's film. I also want to discuss how the prewar State Shinto at its peak was dismantled, contrasted with sturdy ideals of benevolence.
lines.style: Earnest, wrapping up with a structured research direction

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まさしくその通り、論点を絞れば良い論文になりますよ。次回までに序章を仕上げてください。
lines.en: Exactly right — if you narrow your points, it'll be a fine thesis. Please finish the introduction by next time.
lines.style: Warm, affirming closing direction from the teacher
